about.title: Led by owner Pam McGehee
about.text: Pam and her husband fell in love with Galveston many years ago. After numerous family vacations, girls' trips and weekend getaways with their daughters, Pam decided to invest in their favorite hidden gem and St. Gemma Properties was born. With over 16 years of experience in vacation rental ownership, St. Gemma Properties boasts the expertise and longevity for a successful vacation rental experience.
about.imageAlt: Pam McGehee outside a St. Gemma Properties vacation home

reviews.author: Indra F.
reviews.text: My recent stay at La Onda Azul in Galveston, Texas, was absolutely fantastic. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the host's warm hospitality and the immaculate condition of the property.

reviews.author: Jeff B.
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at Twist of Lime! Pamela is without question the most responsive and kindest host. Our party of 16 said how comfortable the house was, not an easy feat for such a large party!

reviews.author: Jody M.
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of staying in several of St. Gemma Properties and each was outstanding. They were close to the beach, shopping and some excellent dining.
